rule.name: UnboundedReactiveFanOut
rule.message: This Reactor operator subscribes to a remote or message call for every element of a collection: Mono.zip, Mono.when and Flux.zip over a list built per element start every call at once, and flatMap or Flux.merge without a concurrency argument run up to 256 at once, so a large collection exhausts the connections or rate limit of the remote service. Pass a concurrency limit (flatMap(this::fetch, 8)), use concatMap for one call at a time, or buffer(20) and make one batch call per chunk; for a zip, use Flux.fromIterable(items).flatMap(this::fetch, 8).collectList(). An exception fits only when the collection is always small.
